cd /app/tmp && cat > medcheck.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys
PROG="/app/submission/scheduler.py"; REF="/app/tmp/ref.py"
def run(prog, data):
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I","-B",prog],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert r.returncode==0, (r.returncode, r.stderr[:300])
    return json.loads(r.stdout)
bad=0
for seed in range(12):
    rnd=random.Random(seed*77+1)
    mode = "stream" if seed%2==0 else "burst"
    Q=rnd.randint(1,6); L=rnd.randint(1,4); U=rnd.choice([8,20,100]); R=rnd.randint(1,min(8,U))
    borders=[0]+sorted(rnd.sample(range(1,U),R-1))+[U] if R>1 else [0,U]
    if mode=="stream":
        steps=[];t=0;nid=0
        for k in range(250):
            t+=rnd.randint(1,4)
            n=rnd.randint(0,L); lanes=rnd.sample(range(L),n); arr=[]
            for ln in lanes:
                arr.append({"id":"m%d"%nid,"lane":ln,"rank":rnd.randrange(U)}); nid+=1
            rnd.shuffle(arr)
            steps.append({"t":t,"serve":rnd.random()<0.6,"arrivals":arr})
        req={"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
             "capacity":rnd.choice([1,2,5]),"epoch":rnd.choice([0,1,3,7]),"steps":steps}
    else:
        packets=[{"id":"m%d"%i,"lane":rnd.randrange(L),"rank":rnd.randrange(U)} for i in range(400)]
        req={"mode":"burst","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,
             "start_bank":rnd.randrange(Q),"packets":packets}
    data=json.dumps(req).encode()
    got=run(PROG,data); exp=run(REF,data)
    if got!=exp:
        bad+=1; print("MISMATCH seed",seed, json.dumps(req)[:600])
        open("/app/tmp/medmm%d.json"%seed,"w").write(json.dumps(req))
    else:
        # extra invariants
        if mode=="burst":
            for rg in got["ranges"]:
                assert rg["observed"]<=rg["bound"], ("cert", rg)
        else:
            f=got["final"]
            assert f["totals"]["accepted"]==f["totals"]["departed"]+sum(len(q) for q in f["queues"])
            assert f["totals"]["attempted"]==f["totals"]["accepted"]+f["totals"]["dropped"]
            # events count == steps count
            assert len(got["events"])==len(req["steps"])
print("medcheck bad=",bad)
PYEOF
python3 medcheck.py
